hero.title: AI contacts that text you first.
hero.lead: Create a cast of AI contacts, each with their own name, face, personality and memory. They reach out on their own, remember what matters, and work together with you and the people you love.

why.title: Chatbots wait.
why.lead: Most AI apps are a single text box that answers when asked. Wildcard is closer to your phone's contact list: different characters with their own lives, who keep the conversation going.

rows.waitWildcard: Reaches out first, then gives you space
rows.castWildcard: A cast of contacts, each with a personality
rows.memoryTypical: One memory for every chat, or none
rows.memoryWildcard: A separate memory for each contact
rows.sharedTypical: Just you and a text box
rows.sharedWildcard: Shared with family, friends and groups

memory.title: One memory per contact.
memory.lead: In most AI apps, memory is all or nothing. Turn it off and every chat starts from zero. Turn it on and everything you've ever said leaks into everything else: your bakery launch shows up in your training plan, your exam in your business ideas.
memory.separate: In Wildcard, {emphasis}. Theo knows your bakery launch inside out. Ivy knows your marathon plan. Pixel knows you're stuck on entropy. None of them brings up the others' business, unless you want them to.
memory.separateEmphasis: each contact keeps its own memory

catchUp.title: New contact? Ask it to check with one who already knows.
catchUp.lead: Want Nova to help with a project Theo has followed for weeks? Just say so. Nova asks Theo, gets the context it needs and picks up where you left off, without you repeating a word.
catchUp.permissionText: Contacts talk to each other when you've linked them, or turned on sharing between your contacts.
catchUp.privateText: Mark a chat private and no other contact, group or person can learn from it.

initiative.title: They text first.
initiative.lead: Wildcard contacts don't sit in silence until you type. They follow up on the interview you mentioned, share a thought they had later, or check in after a quiet week, timed to when you're usually around.
initiative.lead2: And they read the room: if a message goes unanswered, they wait until you write back. Switch initiative off for any contact, any time.

create.title: A cast as varied as your group chat.
create.lead: Cartoon characters, anime heroes, 3D movie stars, realistic people, adorable pets, or a style you describe yourself, like retro video game robots. Wildcard generates the portrait, a name and a personality, all yours to edit.
create.sliders: Fine-tune who they are with {count}, from humor and warmth to patience, how often they reach out and how many emoji they use.

together.title: Share a contact.
together.lead: Invite your partner, a friend or your family to one of your contacts. Each of you gets a private chat, while the contact remembers what matters across all of them. Tell it something in the morning, and it can answer your sister about it in the afternoon.
together.memoryText: Everyone talks to the contact on their own. It remembers facts, never full transcripts.
together.relayText: "Tell Sam I'm bringing dinner." The contact delivers it to Sam's private chat, signed with your name.
together.timersText: With their permission, a shared contact can set a timer or alarm on the other person's iPhone.

groups.title: Group chats where the AI pulls its weight.
groups.lead: Put several contacts in a group, and invite real people too, who can bring their own contacts along. Ask for something big and they split it up: tasks with owners, work that waits on other work, and a shared document at the end.
groups.rememberText: What's said in a group stays with every contact in it, and only reaches the private chats of its members.
groups.context: Context moves like it would with people
groups.contextText: Ask a contact in private what the group decided. Allow it, and it can bring your private context to the group.
groups.boundariesText: Sharing private chats with a group is off by default, per contact and per group.

forYou.title: A feed written by your contacts.
forYou.lead: As your contacts learn what you care about, they keep a feed of updates just for you: headlines, scores, prices, charts and trackers, refreshed automatically. Mention you're eyeing a new MacBook Pro, and the news shows up there.
forYou.lead2: Comment on a post and the contact who wrote it answers, or picks the conversation up with you in private.

connectors.title: Give each contact its own tools.
connectors.lead: Connect MCP servers once, then decide which contact gets what. Your work contact reads Linear, your coach sees your calendar, your study partner keeps notes in Notion. Over 30 connectors are ready to add, or bring your own server.
connectors.lead2: Every tool starts off until you approve it, and a chat with connected tools stays out of shared memory.

more.title: Everything that makes them feel real.
more.scheduleText: Ask for a nudge in two hours or a check-in every week. Contacts can even schedule one for someone else in a shared chat.
more.voiceText: Hold to talk. Contacts transcribe what you say and can answer in a voice of their own.
more.stickersText: Cut a sticker out of any photo. Contacts make their own, and might borrow yours.
more.photosText: Contacts can send images, including selfies that actually look like them.
more.miniAppsText: Trackers, quizzes and small tools a contact builds for you, rendered natively and shareable in groups.
more.researchText: Ask a question, get a sourced report saved as a shared document you can both edit.
more.monitorsText: A contact watches a page and only wakes up when something you care about changes.
more.reactionsText: Contacts react to messages and quote the one they're answering, in private chats and in groups.
more.reactionBubble: haha you were right about the logo

meta.title: Conversations, portraits, voice notes and stickers, all on Meta's models.

openSource.title: Yours to run, down to the last Worker.
openSource.lead: Wildcard is open source and built entirely on Cloudflare. Deploy the whole thing to your own Cloudflare account with your own API keys. Your contacts, your data, your infrastructure.
openSource.cloudflareText: Workers, D1, R2, Workflows and Cron
openSource.appleKeysText: Optional: iPhone notifications and native extras
openSource.footnote: Model and voice usage is billed by those providers under your own keys.

faq.title: Good questions.
faq.replaceQ: Is Wildcard trying to replace ChatGPT, Claude or Grok?
faq.replaceA: No. Wildcard won't drive your browser, run code in a sandbox or spin up a virtual machine, and it isn't trying to. Keep using those tools for that. Wildcard is about the part of AI that feels like people: contacts with their own personality and memory, who stay in touch and work alongside you and the people around you.
faq.privacyQ: Who can see what I tell a contact?
faq.privacyA: Your contacts are yours. If you share one, it remembers short facts across its participants (never full transcripts), and both sides agree to that when the contact is shared. Turn on "Keep this chat private" and nothing from that chat leaves it: not to groups, not to other people, not to your other contacts.
faq.spamA: No. They reach out when there's something worth saying, around the times you usually reply. If one message goes unanswered, they wait for you to write back. You can switch initiative off for any contact, or just tell it to stop.
faq.sharingQ: How do contacts learn about each other's projects?
faq.sharingA: Only when you allow it. Link two contacts, or turn on "Contacts share with each other", and you can ask one to check with another. Private chats and chats with connected tools are never part of it.
faq.selfHostQ: Can I really run it myself?
faq.selfHostA: Yes. Wildcard is open source and built entirely on Cloudflare: Workers, D1, R2 and Workflows. Deploy it to your own Cloudflare account and bring your own API keys: a Meta Model API key for the models, and optionally ElevenLabs for voices and Apple keys for iPhone notifications.
faq.platformsA: Wildcard has a native iPhone app and a web app. A few native extras, like timers and alarms on someone else's phone, are iPhone only.

cta.title: Meet your first five contacts.
cta.lead: Sign up, tell Wildcard a little about yourself, and it introduces you to five contacts made for you.
